name: DaVinci Vertical Short Project Setup
use_when: A short-form edit is being built in DaVinci Resolve for Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts.
The agent needs a simple postable vertical talking-head edit before Fusion polish.
A-roll and B-roll need to be assembled quickly in Resolve.
avoid_when: The delivery is horizontal long-form or square.
The project settings are already locked by a client or previous edit.
The source layout requires custom crop/pad decisions before project settings are changed.

timeline_pattern.pattern: new_project -> shift_9_project_settings -> use_vertical_resolution -> import_a_roll_b_roll -> clean_cuts -> motivated_broll -> remove_broll_audio -> auto_captions
timeline_pattern.page_rule: Use Edit page for assembly and Fusion page for custom motion/text work.
timeline_pattern.effects_rule: Keep Effects Library and Inspector open while building short-form edits.
timeline_pattern.broll_rule: Collect roughly 3-4 B-roll shots for a simple short and place them only on key lines.

motion.rule: Start with clean vertical framing before adding zooms, overlays, or Fusion effects.

sound.rule: Delete or mute B-roll source audio unless it is intentionally part of the design.

captions.rule: Auto captions can create a simple postable reel; style and position them before export.

color.rule: Do not apply LUTs or style looks until vertical crop, B-roll, and captions are readable.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use scale/crop/pad to create a 9:16 canvas, then layer A-roll, B-roll, and captions after timing is locked.
implementation.remotion: Set composition dimensions to vertical and represent A-roll, B-roll, subtitle, and polish layers as named sequences.
implementation.blender: Use vertical camera resolution and safe areas if rendering custom inserts.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Set project aspect to 9:16, cut A-roll, add motivated B-roll, mute B-roll audio, then add auto captions.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Create a vertical sequence, assemble A-roll/B-roll, unlink or mute B-roll audio, and create captions from transcript.

common_mistakes: Forgetting to enable vertical resolution before placing captions and overlays.
Keeping B-roll audio that clashes with the talking head.
Putting B-roll in random places instead of on important statements.
Jumping into Fusion before the simple cut is clean.
qc: Is the project or composition set to vertical delivery?
Are A-roll cuts tight with no accidental dead air over 300 ms?
Is B-roll placed on key lines and not random filler?
Is unwanted B-roll audio removed or muted?
Are simple captions readable and centered/safe before polish begins?
